android.notes: Strategies moves today's PnL on to the new day at midnight UTC. Admins see what open trades are worth in SOL on Trading.

ios.notes: Sweeps get a broomstick. Payout alerts show the dollar value next to SOL, the sweep number and the SOL price, with the HAQQ Terminal logo. A sweep's page shows your payout in SOL and dollars, with more in Details.
